title: The Deep Safehouse
author: Gideon Reyes
blurb: August Zhou, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
